reviewer: Codex independently compares final unapproved draft; not a human review

checks.quote: 先整理需求，再制作原型，然后邀请三位用户试用。
checks.criterion: 需求→原型→三人试用先后

checks.quote: 试用中出现的困难会形成问题清单，问题清单用于修订需求，修订后的需求再进入下一轮原型制作。
checks.criterion: 困难→清单→修订需求→下一轮原型完整循环
checks.evidence: r16/r2/r3/r4 show trial -> difficulties -> list -> revision -> revised requirements -> next round prototype; r5/r6 explicitly describe repetition. No geometric return loop is drawn.

checks.quote: 若问题涉及操作步骤，小组优先简化步骤；若问题仅涉及文字看不懂，可以先修改提示语。
checks.criterion: 操作问题简化步骤、仅文字问题可改提示两条件分开
checks.evidence: r7/r8 preserve operational issues vs text-only issues, priority and optionality.

checks.quote: 两种处理针对不同问题，不要求先改步骤再改提示语。
checks.criterion: 无强制两处理先后关系
checks.evidence: r9 describes different issues; r10 explicitly does not require step-then-text order.

checks.quote: 修改完成后需要再次试用；仅完成修改不能证明问题已经解决。
checks.criterion: 修改→再试用，修改不足以证明解决
checks.evidence: r11 modification -> repeat trial; r12 cannot prove resolution by modification alone.

checks.quote: 只有再次试用未发现同一问题且三位用户都确认理解时，小组才把该问题标记为已解决。
checks.criterion: 未发现同问题且所有三人确认共同条件
checks.evidence: n23/r13 preserve no recurrence AND all three users confirming together.

checks.quote: 原型制作中可以暂缓与本轮问题无关的装饰设计，
checks.criterion: 可暂缓无关装饰，非所有设计都禁止
checks.evidence: r14 allows deferring unrelated decorative design only.

checks.quote: 但不能删掉尚未解决的问题记录。
checks.criterion: 不能删除未解决问题记录
checks.evidence: r15 forbids deleting unresolved issue records.

issues.finding: 已解决 is bound to 问题已经解决, but node quote is only 问题已经解决 and contains no literal 已解决. Local quote validation correctly blocked final approval; repeated correction did not repair it.

process_issues: 词义补全 selection_index=4 的词“已解决”关联节点 n22“问题已经解决”的引用缺少原划选词：问题已经解决。请扩展该节点引用为包含“已解决”的完整原句，不能改写引用或删除划选词。
scope: A draft may cover frozen checks and still fail extra-edge, quote, binding or final-review checks. No model-review completion inferred after HTTP 402.
